additional_info.subject: ID0390624-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2 / R2 312900727008] HMI Flickering CRM:00642001808
additional_info.body:
Hello Orel,
Hope you are doing great.
Regarding the issue of the HMI screen flickering, please check the following:
Ensure there are no loose connections to the screen and board.
Update the Dlogic firmware if it hasn't been done recently.
Check the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board (PH2).
Verify if the DP cables have been replaced with this charger. If not, we recommend replacing them with new DP cables.
If the issue persists after these checks, we suggest replacing the control panel with Generation 2. Please find the MLFB number for the adaptation set below:
8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6: Adaptation Set
